---
title: "F-BC — Broadcast"
status: "Canonical"
layer: 1
---

*F-BC* (Broadcast) is part of *Layer 1: Channels, Agreement, Ledgers* in the UC functionality encyclopedia. Status: a canonical, well-established UC functionality.

As usually formulated, this functionality is not realizable against adaptive adversaries; a weakened variant is needed in that setting.

*References:*

- Canetti. *Universally composable security: A new paradigm for cryptographic protocols*. In 42nd IEEE Symposium on Foundations of Computer Science (FOCS), pages 136–145, 2001.
- Hirt and Zikas. *Adaptively secure broadcast*. In Advances in Cryptology – EUROCRYPT 2010, 2010.
- Garay et al. *Adaptively secure broadcast, revisited*. In 30th ACM Symposium on Principles of Distributed Computing (PODC), 2011.
